problem: The candidate validates every supplied frameProfileType value against nltl:frameProfileTypeValue even though I2.6.1 imposes no frame-profile-type requirement, so unrelated profile data can cause regulatory nonconformance.
required_change: Remove the frameProfileType property constraint from generated:ShipShape.
regression_guard: Do not impose presence, type, or value constraints on frameProfileType unless an applicable authoritative requirement explicitly requires them.

problem: The ForceQuantityValueShape constraint on patchLoad applies unconditionally to every targeted ship, allowing malformed patch-load data to invalidate ships with no bottom-structure member even though the patch-load requirement applies only to bottom structures.
required_change: Scope patchLoad quantity validation to ships having a bottom-structure member, together with the existing conditional presence requirement, rather than applying it to every ship.
regression_guard: Keep patch-load presence and quantity validation conditional on bottom-structure applicability.
